# Web Developer | Hassan Biswas — UI/UX & Front-End Architecture

> Freelance Front-End Developer & UI/UX Specialist based in Jashore, Khulna, Bangladesh. Specializing in transforming Figma, Framer, and Webflow designs into clean, responsive, accessible, high-performance, and SEO-friendly digital experiences using pure HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript with Awwwards-inspired aesthetics.

Hassan Biswas is a Web Developer based in Jashore, Khulna, Bangladesh with 3+ years of experience in front-end development, custom Web Components, zero-dependency lightweight architectures, and modern web performance optimization.

---

## Core Specializations & Services

- **UI/UX & Web Design:** Transforming Figma, Framer, Webflow, and Relume concepts into clean, pixel-perfect user interfaces, wireframes, and design systems.
- **Front-End Architecture:** High-performance, modular, zero-dependency lightweight web architectures built with vanilla HTML5, native CSS3 (HSL color systems), and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
- **Figma / Design-to-Code Conversion:** Fast, SEO-optimized, responsive static sites built with pixel-perfect accuracy and Awwwards-inspired layouts.
- **Performance, SEO & Accessibility:** Optimizing Core Web Vitals, accessibility standards (WCAG), semantic HTML structure, and search engine discoverability.
- **Custom Components & Automation:** Reusable custom Web Components, custom JS logic, zero-maintenance deployments, and GitHub Actions CI/CD release workflows.

---
